description: Local Groups GPO authored via GPMC Editor — Machine scope (3 items: update/replace/delete) and User scope (1 item: create with FilterGroup ILT and userAction=REMOVE)
classification_note: Authored through gpme.msc on Windows Server 2025 and captured via Backup-GPO. GPMC natively emitted all elements.

origin.method: Backup-GPO on Windows Server 2025 build 26100, PowerShell 5.1

items.windows_meaning: Update built-in Administrators group: add HRAENET\svc-gpolens and HRAENET\lab-admins. Description set to 'Managed by GPO Studio'. Does not delete existing users/groups.
Replace built-in Power Users group: delete all existing users and groups, then add HRAENET\dev-team. removePolicy=1.
Delete the local group 'test-delete-group'. Action Delete: remove the group if it exists.

Create user-scope group 'dev-team' with userAction=REMOVE (remove members instead of add at user logon). Adds HRAENET\ünïcode-test-group. FilterGroup ILT targets HRAENET\Domain Users. FilterRunOnce promoted to apply_once.

parser_gaps.gap: parse_gpp_collection routes <Group> to parse_gpp_groups (GppGroup), not parse_gpp_local_groups; collection.local_groups is always empty
parser_gaps.impact: The collection-based parse path cannot produce GppLocalGroup items with groupSid fidelity

parser_gaps.gap: GppLocalGroup model has no group_sid or user_action field
parser_gaps.impact: groupSid and userAction attributes from GPMC are lost on the model path

parser_gaps.gap: collect_gpp_collections does not discover User/Preferences/Groups/Groups.xml from backup directories
parser_gaps.impact: User-scope group items are not imported via the public backup path
parser_gaps.note: collect_gpp_collections now discovers all GPP adapter files
